thread:
marie: Heads up — someone left an open jar of hazelnut spread on the counter. We have at least two folks with nut allergies, can the owner please label it or move it to a shelf? @kitchen-ops
jamal: Not mine — I only brought maple syrup this morning. noted and thx for flagging.
sofia: I’ll pop a sticky label on it when I get back. also oat milk is almost gone. anyone doing a coffee run around 3pm?
trevor: I can do a quick run at ~3:15. what’s needed? list here or drop emojis and I’ll grab. :coffee: :croissant: :bread:
marie: Oat milk x2, decaf pods, whole milk, one plain croissant and one almond croissant? (PS almond croissant = contains nuts so maybe skip if people affected)
lex: Skip the almond croissant pls — allergic person in 5B. I’ll take a plain croissant and two black coffees. :raised_hands:
jamal: Can we also get a small jar of honey? For tea. And maybe some banana + yogurt cups.
kitchen-ops: Noted — fridge rule reminder: label leftovers with name + date. If unlabeled for >72h it gets tossed. I’ll update the sticky note on the fridge.
pantry-bot: Inventory alert — oat_milk=1 carton, decaf_pods=4, croissants=0, bananas=6. Low items flagged.
sofia: Also quick poll: should we start a $5/mo optional pantry fund to cover basics (milk, filters, occasional pastries)? Reply :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no. Link to tiny spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/snack-fund
trevor: :thumbsup: from me. If it makes quick runs easier, worth it.
marie: Putting a very small sign-up for volunteers to alternate runs this month so one person isn’t always running errands. tiny sheet under the snack fund link.
lex: I’ll do the run this time. jamal — can you Venmo me $6 for the honey + oatmilk?
jamal: yep sending now. thanks lex!
sofia: labeling done. I moved the hazelnut jar to the top shelf and added a big "NUTS" sticky.
marie: Thanks everybody. Trevor — ping when you leave and I’ll meet you in the lobby to grab an extra grocery bag for the yogurt cups.
trevor: On my way at 3:12.
marie: <3
